note: Reviewed reference data for Migration 039. Market groups follow the observed signing markets (signings.country_market): the four markets with enough signings to describe on their own, then regional groups. Eras are the league rules for international amateur signings; professional routes are not placed on the amateur era scale. A NULL market is UNKNOWN, never guessed.

eras.label: Before international bonus pools
eras.rule_summary: International amateur signings before the bonus-pool system: no league-wide signing budget per club.
eras.source_reference: 2012-2016 Basic Agreement (international talent system effective with the signing period beginning 2 July 2012)

eras.label: Bonus pools with overage penalties (2012-13 to 2016-17)
eras.rule_summary: Each club had an international bonus pool; exceeding it was allowed and penalised by an overage tax and, above thresholds, later maximum-bonus restrictions.
eras.source_reference: 2012-2016 Basic Agreement, international talent acquisition rules

eras.label: Hard-capped bonus pools (2017-18 onward)
eras.rule_summary: Each club has a hard-capped international bonus pool that cannot be exceeded; the signing period has opened on 15 January since 2021.
eras.source_reference: 2017-2021 Basic Agreement (and its successor), international bonus pool rules
